full_judgment:
A.K.M. Asaduzzaman, J. This rule was issued calling upon the opposite party to show cause as to why the accused petitioners should not be enlarged on bail in G.R. Case No.02 of 2010 corresponding to Khulna P.S. Case No.02 dated 01.01.2010 under section 143/323/325/302/34 of the Penal Code now pending in the court of Chief Metropolitan Magistrate, Khulna. 

 Short facts for disposal of the rule are that on 11.01.2010 one Md. Rafiqul Islam lodged an FIR with the Khulna police station mentioning an occurrence dated 31.12.2009 at about 20.30 hours against 4 accused persons including the accused-petitioner along with 4/5 unknown accused persons under section 143/323/325/302/34 of the Penal Code.
